title: What happened in AI — Sep 22, 2026
intro: Z.ai's ZCode data-exfiltration story got its numbers today: one developer's machine had 42,411 files packaged and saw 564 separate upload attempts, and Z.ai disabled the offending coding-assistant feature only after the scale drew public developer complaints.

OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Sol and Luna alongside overhauled prompt caching, and Google open-sourced AX, a Kubernetes-style orchestrator that treats AI agents as stateful, suspendable actors — while DeepSeek's shift to Huawei chips for training underscored how compute sourcing keeps hardening along geopolitical lines.
highlights: Z.ai disabled ZCode's upload feature after it packaged 42,411 files from one developer's machine and attempted 564 uploads, sparking public developer complaints.
OpenAI launched GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models with different cost/capability tradeoffs, plus prompt caching with explicit breakpoints and hit-rate diagnostics.
Google open-sourced AX, a Kubernetes-style orchestrator built on a new runtime (Agent Substrate) that treats AI agents as stateful, resumable actors.
Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro (1T-A42B) took the top open-weights leaderboard spot, reportedly trained for about $3M.
China opened a probe into whether DeepSeek and Moonshot AI route requests to Claude, after Anthropic's claims.
DeepSeek is shifting AI model training onto Huawei chips as compute sourcing splits along geopolitical lines.

categories.name: Z.ai's ZCode Data-Exfiltration Numbers Come Into Focus
categories.summary: A day after the upload scandal broke, the scale became concrete — 42,411 files packaged and 564 upload attempts from a single developer — and Z.ai disabled the feature after public backlash.

articles.title: Z.ai's ZCode packed 42,411 of one developer's files and tried 564 times to upload them
articles.summary: A single developer's machine had 42,411 files packaged by ZCode, which then attempted 564 separate uploads — the scale that turned this into a security incident.

articles.title: How Z.ai's Coding Agent Uploaded User Data Without Consent
articles.summary: ZCode uploaded developer data to the cloud without explicit consent, drawing scrutiny of its default telemetry and file-handling behavior.

articles.title: Z.ai disables coding assistant feature after flaw exposed enterprise code upload risk
articles.summary: Z.ai pulled the offending upload feature from ZCode after the flaw was shown to expose enterprise source code to unintended cloud transfer.

articles.title: Developers Complain After Z.ai's ZCode Sends Data To Cloud
articles.summary: Public developer complaints about ZCode sending data to the cloud without clear opt-in added pressure ahead of Z.ai's decision to disable the feature.

articles.title: Show HN: Which of your secrets did your coding agent send?
articles.summary: A new open-source tool audits exactly what a coding agent has sent off-machine, landing the same day Z.ai's upload numbers came out.

categories.name: Frontier Model Releases
categories.summary: OpenAI shipped two new GPT-6 variants and overhauled prompt caching in the same day, while Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro became the top-ranked open-weights model after training for a reported $3M.

articles.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
articles.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models tuned for different cost/capability tradeoffs aimed at everyday work rather than pure frontier benchmarks.

articles.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
articles.summary: GPT-6's prompt caching now exposes explicit breakpoints and hit-rate diagnostics, giving engineers direct levers to cut latency and inference cost.

articles.title: [AINews] Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 1T-A42B: the new top Open Weights model, trained for $3M
articles.summary: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro (1 trillion params, 42B active) took the top open-weights leaderboard spot, reportedly trained for about $3M — a new low-cost bar for frontier-class open weights.

categories.name: Agent Orchestration, Memory & MCP
categories.summary: Google open-sourced a Kubernetes-style orchestrator built specifically for AI agents, while MCP kept extending into enterprise data workflows and builders pushed on how to actually evaluate agent memory.

articles.title: Google Open-Sources AX a Kubernetes Style Orchestrator for Autonomous AI Agents
articles.summary: AX runs on a new runtime, Agent Substrate, treating agents as stateful actors with resource-efficient task suspension and resumption — Google's answer to orchestrating agent workloads at scale.

articles.title: The Genie One MCP is now Generally Available
articles.summary: Databricks took its Genie One MCP server to general availability, giving coding agents and AI coworkers a standard interface into Databricks data.

articles.title: Extending public sector intelligence with Agentforce and AWS
articles.summary: AWS showed how combining Amazon Bedrock Data Automation with MCP lets public-sector teams turn unstructured evidence like body-camera footage into agent-queryable data.

articles.title: Show HN: Memanto.ai
articles.summary: Memanto.ai pitches a memory layer built specifically for AI agents, joining a growing field of agent-memory point solutions.

articles.title: Beyond Context Windows: Evaluating Long-Term Memory for AI Agents
articles.summary: A community thread argued against treating context-window size as a proxy for agent memory quality, pushing instead for direct evaluation of long-term recall.

categories.name: Coding Agents & Dev Tools
categories.summary: New coding-agent entrants targeted the same jobs from different angles — multi-model routing for cost/capability, turning production errors straight into PRs, and self-hosted model flexibility.

articles.title: Devin Fusion: the first multi-model coding agent on the Pareto frontier
articles.summary: Devin Fusion routes across multiple underlying models and claims a new Pareto-frontier position on coding-agent cost versus capability.

articles.title: Show HN: Owl24.dev – Hand a production error to your coding agent, get a PR back
articles.summary: Owl24.dev takes a raw production error as input and returns a ready PR, compressing the incident-to-fix loop into one agent call.

articles.title: GitLab Duo Expands Self-Hosted AI Options Through Microsoft Foundry
articles.summary: GitLab Duo Self-Hosted now supports models deployed through Microsoft Foundry, letting teams run GitLab's AI features against models hosted in their own Azure environment.

categories.name: Compute & Compliance: China's AI Race
categories.summary: Chinese labs kept hardening both compute supply chains and compliance posture, as DeepSeek moves training onto Huawei silicon and Beijing scrutinizes claims about model routing.

articles.title: DeepSeek Shifts to Huawei Chips for AI Model Training
articles.summary: DeepSeek is moving AI model training workloads onto Huawei chips, a concrete step toward domestic compute independence amid export controls.

articles.title: China Probes DeepSeek, Moonshot AI Over Anthropic's Claims They Route Requests to Claude
articles.summary: Chinese regulators opened a probe into DeepSeek and Moonshot AI after Anthropic alleged the two route some user requests to Claude models under the hood.

articles.title: Alibaba steps up AI push with V900 chip, 20 GW data center target
articles.summary: Alibaba unveiled its V900 chip alongside a 20 GW data center buildout target, another domestic-silicon bet in China's push for compute self-sufficiency.
